tips.text: Do not mix pets up: Kubrow imprints do not work for Kavats, and Kavat imprints do not work for Kubrow.
Be sure before starting an imprint; it cannot be cancelled, and the Kubrow is unusable until it finishes.
Egg farming is the part players complain about; reports run from one run to dozens for a single egg.
Expect days of calendar time, bounded by the 24 or 48 hour incubation on each attempt.
